sonnet.problem: The card says "This is the same song that says…", which ties the words in verse 46 to the song. Verse 46 says only "all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day," and the text doesn't say that means the song. The card also points back to a verse (32:7) that no earlier card has shown.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: Card 13 already said this part "hurts." Card 20 says again that "that one's heavy," and then adds a joke about the apron. A heavy moment is named once, and this one is named twice.
sonnet.rule: He can say once, simply, that a part is heavy.
